audit_kind: offline lexical audit of exact published SDK source packages

evidence_scope.archives: Every exact-version cached crate archive is SHA-256 checked against sdk-services.json.
evidence_scope.capabilities: Public config method declarations and generated operation classifier registrations are matched lexically. Counts are source evidence, not compiled or exercised behavior.
evidence_scope.source: Names and versions are parsed from each local Cargo.toml. Config, operation, paginator and waiter sources are read and fingerprinted. Source fingerprints are independent of archive verification; unpacked files are not byte-compared against archive entries.
